articles.summary: SANTA CLARA, Calif., July 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Applied Materials, Inc. today announced that it will hold its fiscal third quarter 2026 earnings conference call on Thursday, Aug. 13, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. ET / 1:30 p.m. PT. The call will be webcast live at: https://ir.appliedmaterials.com.
articles.title: Applied Materials to Report Fiscal Third Quarter 2026 Results on Aug. 13, 2026
